title: Nested Whole-Set Confidence Intervals for Causal Slopes with Leaky Instruments at Flat Faces
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier incremental below field floor; paper score ceiling 5.4 < 7.4; salvageable=false after adaptive certificate failure
gap_reasons: The note proves arbitrary-accuracy computability, exact coverage, causal transfer, and only a very small positive lower bound on the nesting penalty, but it does not deliver the requested quantitative value of V or an efficient certificate.

Its sole executed adaptive computation is explicitly noncertifying and exhibits estimated noncoverage above 0.05, while the proved fallback has astronomical dimensions and no usable complexity guarantee.
The causal interpretation is additionally confined to a fixed isotropic Gaussian local subclass, and the penalty bound establishes strictness without determining its economically relevant magnitude.
related_work_incomplete@thm:adaptive-certificate (decision-panel editorial finding, unrepaired at the tier halt)
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established the two-coordinate reduction, endpoint closure, an exactly honest dense rational construction at arbitrary accuracy, a positive nesting surcharge, restricted Watson-class inclusion, and causal transfer. Three adaptive-certificate attempts did not produce an executed outward-rounded primal-dual certificate below 1e-5; the audit reports certified=false and estimated noncoverage 0.060302734375, while the dense fallback is computationally prohibitive. A future run needs a new active-constraint reduction and independently checkable continuum primal and dual witnesses before claiming field-tier calibration.
tldr: At the absolute-leakage flat face of the two-instrument model, the sharp local causal-slope set has a continuum of upper endpoints, so separately optimal endpoint tests cannot generally be inverted into one nested interval. The note proves the exact two-coordinate reduction, endpoint closure, randomized attainment, a finite dense rational certificate with an exact full-continuum bracket at every rational tolerance, deterministic causal transfer including ties, the explicit inclusion of the transfer path in the Gaussian two-instrument \(p=1\), \(\tau=1\) Watson subclass, and \(V-L_{\mathrm{NP}}\geq1/4384000000>1/5000000000\). The requested adaptive outward-rounded \(10^{-5}\) computation was attempted but failed closed: its preserved receipt is noncertifying and exhibits a heuristic coverage failure. Under the stated early-kill criterion, the achieved contribution is below the field floor.
